words.chinese: 是；成为
words.exampleEn: Safety rules are there to protect everyone on site.
words.exampleZh: 安全规定是为了保护工地上的每一个人。

words.chinese: 有；进行
words.exampleEn: We had a toolbox meeting before the shift started.
words.exampleZh: 班次开始前我们开了一次工具箱安全会。

words.chinese: 做
words.exampleEn: She did the inspection and signed the form.
words.exampleZh: 她完成了检查并在表格上签了字。

words.chinese: 去
words.exampleEn: He went to the tool crib to sign out a drill.
words.exampleZh: 他去工具房登记领取电钻。

words.chinese: 得到；变得
words.exampleEn: You will get used to the site rules in the first week.
words.exampleZh: 第一周你就会习惯工地的规定。
words.notes: 美式过去分词常用 gotten，英式常用 got。

words.chinese: 做；使
words.exampleEn: A clear drawing makes the assembly much safer.
words.exampleZh: 图纸清楚会让装配安全得多。

words.chinese: 拿；花费
words.exampleEn: It took three hours to replace the damaged pipe.
words.exampleZh: 更换损坏的管道花了三个小时。

words.chinese: 来
words.exampleEn: A supervisor came over when the alarm sounded.
words.exampleZh: 警报响起时主管走了过来。

words.chinese: 看见
words.exampleEn: I have seen this fault on the panel before.
words.exampleZh: 我以前在这块面板上见过这种故障。

words.chinese: 知道
words.exampleEn: You should know the emergency exits on every floor.
words.exampleZh: 你应该知道每层楼的紧急出口。

words.chinese: 认为；思考
words.exampleEn: I thought the measurement was in millimetres.
words.exampleZh: 我以为这个尺寸是毫米。

words.chinese: 给
words.exampleEn: The instructor gave us a checklist for the assessment.
words.exampleZh: 老师给了我们一份测评清单。

words.chinese: 找到；发现
words.exampleEn: They found a crack near the weld.
words.exampleZh: 他们在焊缝附近发现了一道裂纹。

words.chinese: 告诉
words.exampleEn: Tell the first-aid attendant if anyone feels dizzy.
words.exampleZh: 如果有人感到头晕，要告诉急救员。

words.chinese: 变成
words.exampleEn: The surface became slippery after the rain.
words.exampleZh: 下雨后地面变得很滑。

words.chinese: 离开；留下
words.exampleEn: Do not leave tools on the ladder.
words.exampleZh: 不要把工具留在梯子上。

words.chinese: 感觉
words.exampleEn: He felt the vibration before the motor failed.
words.exampleZh: 电机故障前他就感觉到了震动。

words.chinese: 放
words.exampleEn: Put the guard back before you restart the machine.
words.exampleZh: 重新开机前先把防护罩装回去。

words.chinese: 带来
words.exampleEn: Please bring your photo ID to the assessment.
words.exampleZh: 参加测评时请带上带照片的身份证件。

words.chinese: 开始
words.exampleEn: The class begins with a short reading task.
words.exampleZh: 这堂课以一段短阅读开始。

words.chinese: 保持；保存
words.exampleEn: Keep the walkway clear at all times.
words.exampleZh: 通道必须始终保持畅通。

words.chinese: 握住；举行
words.exampleEn: The college held an English placement test in August.
words.exampleZh: 学院在八月举行了英语分级考试。

words.chinese: 写
words.exampleEn: Write a short paragraph that supports your claim with evidence.
words.exampleZh: 写一段话，用证据支撑你的论点。

words.chinese: 站立；承受
words.exampleEn: Do not stand under a suspended load.
words.exampleZh: 不要站在悬吊重物下面。

words.chinese: 听见
words.exampleEn: If you hear a hiss, shut the valve immediately.
words.exampleZh: 如果听到嘶嘶声，立即关闭阀门。

words.chinese: 让；允许
words.exampleEn: Do not let unauthorized people enter the work area.
words.exampleZh: 不要让未经授权的人进入作业区。

words.chinese: 意味着；意思是
words.exampleEn: A 50 percent grade means you met the minimum English requirement.
words.exampleZh: 50% 的成绩意味着你达到了英语最低要求。

words.chinese: 设置；放置
words.exampleEn: Set the torque wrench to the specified value.
words.exampleZh: 把扭力扳手设置到规定数值。

words.chinese: 遇见；满足
words.exampleEn: Your English 12 mark must meet the Category 3 requirement.
words.exampleZh: 你的英语 12 成绩必须满足第三类要求。

words.chinese: 跑；运转
words.exampleEn: The pump ran for ten minutes before it overheated.
words.exampleZh: 泵运转了十分钟后过热了。

words.chinese: 支付；注意
words.exampleEn: Pay attention to units when you convert the measurement.
words.exampleZh: 换算尺寸时要注意单位。

words.chinese: 坐
words.exampleEn: Students sat the English trades entry assessment in the morning.
words.exampleZh: 学生上午参加了工科英语入学测评。

words.chinese: 说
words.exampleEn: Speak clearly when you report a hazard to your supervisor.
words.exampleZh: 向主管报告隐患时要说清楚。

words.chinese: 带领；导致
words.exampleEn: Poor communication led to the wrong part being installed.
words.exampleZh: 沟通不清导致装错了零件。

words.chinese: 阅读
words.exampleEn: Read the procedure before you start the lockout.
words.exampleZh: 开始上锁挂牌前先阅读操作程序。
words.notes: 过去式和过去分词拼写仍是 read，发音为 /red/。

words.chinese: 生长；增长
words.exampleEn: Your vocabulary will grow if you review on the forgetting curve.
words.exampleZh: 按遗忘曲线复习，词汇量就会增长。

words.chinese: 失去；丢失
words.exampleEn: Do not lose your assessment confirmation email.
words.exampleZh: 不要把测评确认邮件弄丢。

words.chinese: 落下；下降
words.exampleEn: A falling object can cause a serious injury.
words.exampleZh: 坠落物可能造成重伤。

words.chinese: 发送
words.exampleEn: Send the completed form to the admissions office.
words.exampleZh: 把填好的表格发给招生办。

words.chinese: 建造
words.exampleEn: They built a scaffold along the south wall.
words.exampleZh: 他们沿南墙搭了脚手架。

words.chinese: 理解
words.exampleEn: Make sure you understand the question before you write.
words.exampleZh: 动笔前先确保你理解了题目。

words.chinese: 画；得出
words.exampleEn: Draw a conclusion only after you examine the evidence.
words.exampleZh: 只有在检查证据之后才能得出结论。

words.chinese: 打破；故障
words.exampleEn: The belt broke because it was not aligned.
words.exampleZh: 皮带因为没有对正而断裂了。

words.chinese: 花费
words.exampleEn: Spend twenty minutes each day on mixed review.
words.exampleZh: 每天花二十分钟做混合复习。

words.chinese: 切割
words.exampleEn: Cut the power before you open the panel.
words.exampleZh: 打开配电箱前先切断电源。

words.chinese: 上升
words.exampleEn: The temperature rose above the safe limit.
words.exampleZh: 温度升到了安全上限以上。

words.chinese: 驾驶；驱动
words.exampleEn: He drove the forklift only after he was certified.
words.exampleZh: 他拿到认证后才驾驶叉车。

words.chinese: 购买
words.exampleEn: Buy CSA-approved footwear before the first shop class.
words.exampleZh: 第一次车间课前要买符合 CSA 认证的安全鞋。

words.chinese: 穿戴
words.exampleEn: You must wear eye protection in the shop.
words.exampleZh: 在车间必须戴护目镜。

words.chinese: 选择
words.exampleEn: Choose the most relevant evidence for your paragraph.
words.exampleZh: 为你的段落选择最相关的证据。

words.chinese: 抓住；赶上
words.exampleEn: Catch errors early by checking your work twice.
words.exampleZh: 检查两遍，才能尽早抓住错误。

words.chinese: 赢得
words.exampleEn: You will not win marks for a paragraph with no thesis.
words.exampleZh: 没有中心论点的段落拿不到分数。

words.chinese: 教
words.exampleEn: The course teaches you how to write a supported argument.
words.exampleZh: 这门课教你如何写出有支撑的论证。

words.chinese: 忘记
words.exampleEn: Reviewing just before you forget is the point of spaced practice.
words.exampleZh: 间隔练习的意义，就是在快忘记前复习。

words.chinese: 吃
words.exampleEn: Do not eat in the lab or the shop.
words.exampleZh: 实验室和车间里不要吃东西。

words.chinese: 睡觉
words.exampleEn: He slept poorly before the English assessment.
words.exampleZh: 英语测评前他没睡好。

words.chinese: 隐藏
words.exampleEn: Do not hide a safety incident from your instructor.
words.exampleZh: 不要向老师隐瞒安全事故。

words.chinese: 骑；乘坐
words.exampleEn: She rode the SkyTrain to the Burnaby campus.
words.exampleZh: 她坐 SkyTrain 去本拿比校区。

words.chinese: 结冰；冻结
words.exampleEn: The pipe froze overnight and then burst.
words.exampleZh: 管子一夜结冰，随后爆裂。

words.chinese: 摇动
words.exampleEn: The ladder shook because it was not on level ground.
words.exampleZh: 梯子晃动是因为地面不平。

words.chinese: 偷
words.exampleEn: Do not use a tool that may have been stolen.
words.exampleZh: 不要使用可能是偷来的工具。

words.chinese: 醒来
words.exampleEn: Wake up early enough to review five sentences.
words.exampleZh: 早点起床，复习五个句子。

words.chinese: 卖
words.exampleEn: The bookstore sold the required safety glasses.
words.exampleZh: 书店出售规定的护目镜。

words.chinese: 击打
words.exampleEn: The beam was hit during the lift and must be inspected.
words.exampleZh: 吊装时梁被撞到了，必须检查。

words.chinese: 伤害；疼痛
words.exampleEn: Report it even if you are not badly hurt.
words.exampleZh: 即使伤得不重也要报告。

words.chinese: 关闭
words.exampleEn: Shut the valve and tag it out.
words.exampleZh: 关闭阀门并挂牌上锁。

words.chinese: 花费；代价
words.exampleEn: A small mistake can cost a team a full day of work.
words.exampleZh: 一个小错误可能让全组浪费一整天。

words.chinese: 扩散；铺开
words.exampleEn: Oil spread across the floor after the hose failed.
words.exampleZh: 软管故障后，油在地面上扩散开。

words.chinese: 扔
words.exampleEn: Never throw materials down from a scaffold.
words.exampleZh: 绝不要从脚手架上往下扔材料。

words.chinese: 发誓；咒骂
words.exampleEn: He swore that he had locked out the breaker.
words.exampleZh: 他发誓自己已经把断路器上锁了。

words.chinese: 查阅
words.exampleEn: Look up the word in a dictionary if you are not sure.
words.exampleZh: 不确定就查词典。
words.gapSentence: If you forget a term, _____ it _____ in the glossary.

words.chinese: 照顾；负责
words.exampleEn: Please look after the new apprentice this week.
words.exampleZh: 这周请照顾好新来的学徒。
words.gapSentence: Can you _____ _____ the tools while I am in the meeting?

words.chinese: 寻找
words.exampleEn: Look for the emergency stop before you start the machine.
words.exampleZh: 开机前先找到急停按钮。
words.gapSentence: _____ _____ a certified hard hat in the equipment room.

words.chinese: 调查
words.exampleEn: The supervisor will look into the near-miss report.
words.exampleZh: 主管会调查这份未遂事故报告。
words.gapSentence: We need to _____ _____ why the alarm failed.

words.chinese: 穿上；戴上
words.exampleEn: Put on your safety glasses before you enter the shop.
words.exampleZh: 进入车间前戴上护目镜。
words.gapSentence: _____ _____ hearing protection in the cutting area.

words.chinese: 脱下；起飞
words.exampleEn: Take off any loose jewellery before you work.
words.exampleZh: 工作前摘掉松动的饰品。
words.gapSentence: _____ _____ your gloves before you use the tablet.

words.chinese: 打开（电源）
words.exampleEn: Turn on the exhaust fan before welding.
words.exampleZh: 焊接前打开排风扇。
words.gapSentence: Do not _____ the machine _____ until the guard is in place.

words.chinese: 关闭（电源）
words.exampleEn: Turn off the power and lock it out.
words.exampleZh: 关闭电源并上锁。
words.gapSentence: _____ _____ the breaker before you open the panel.

words.chinese: 捡起；学会
words.exampleEn: You will pick up shop vocabulary faster if you use it daily.
words.exampleZh: 每天使用，车间词汇会学得更快。
words.gapSentence: _____ _____ that extension cord so nobody trips.

words.chinese: 放弃
words.exampleEn: Do not give up when the first draft is weak.
words.exampleZh: 初稿不好也不要放弃。
words.gapSentence: If a sentence is hard, do not _____ _____; review it tomorrow.

words.chinese: 查明
words.exampleEn: Find out the due date for the admissions document.
words.exampleZh: 查明入学材料的截止日期。
words.gapSentence: _____ _____ which English test BCIT will accept.

words.chinese: 执行；实施
words.exampleEn: Carry out the lockout procedure in the correct order.
words.exampleZh: 按正确顺序执行上锁程序。
words.gapSentence: The crew will _____ _____ a full inspection at noon.

words.chinese: 设立；安装
words.exampleEn: Set up the ladder on firm, level ground.
words.exampleZh: 把梯子支在坚实平整的地面上。
words.gapSentence: We need to _____ _____ the workspace before the demo.

words.chinese: 出故障；分解
words.exampleEn: The compressor broke down during the afternoon shift.
words.exampleZh: 压缩机在下午班次出了故障。
words.gapSentence: If the pump _____ _____, tag it and report it.

words.chinese: 提出；想出
words.exampleEn: Come up with a clearer thesis before you rewrite.
words.exampleZh: 重写前先想出一个更清楚的中心论点。
words.gapSentence: Can you _____ _____ _____ two reasons to support this claim?

words.chinese: 计算出；解决
words.exampleEn: Work out the total length before you cut the pipe.
words.exampleZh: 下料前先算出总长度。
words.gapSentence: _____ _____ the scale on the drawing first.

words.chinese: 填写
words.exampleEn: Fill out the incident report while the details are fresh.
words.exampleZh: 趁细节还清楚，把事故报告填好。
words.gapSentence: Please _____ _____ this application form in English.

words.chinese: 仔细检查；复习
words.exampleEn: Go over your paragraph for subject-verb agreement.
words.exampleZh: 检查段落里的主谓一致。
words.gapSentence: Let's _____ _____ the safety points before we start.

words.chinese: 推迟
words.exampleEn: Do not put off the reviews that are due today.
words.exampleZh: 不要把今天到期的复习往后拖。
words.gapSentence: The test was _____ _____ until Friday.

words.chinese: 接管
words.exampleEn: She will take over the next shift at 3 p.m.
words.exampleZh: 她将在下午三点接下一个班。
words.gapSentence: Who will _____ _____ if the lead electrician is away?

words.chinese: 结果是；生产
words.exampleEn: The leak turned out to be a cracked fitting.
words.exampleZh: 结果泄漏是因为接头裂了。
words.gapSentence: It _____ _____ that the drawing used the wrong units.

words.chinese: 提出
words.exampleEn: Bring up any unclear instructions before you start.
words.exampleZh: 开始前把不清楚的指令提出来。
words.gapSentence: He _____ _____ a good point about the thesis statement.

words.chinese: 取消
words.exampleEn: They called off the outdoor work because of high winds.
words.exampleZh: 因为大风，他们取消了户外作业。
words.gapSentence: The instructor may _____ _____ the lab if the equipment is unsafe.

words.chinese: 检查；借出
words.exampleEn: Check out the torque wrench from the tool crib.
words.exampleZh: 从工具房借出扭力扳手。
words.gapSentence: _____ _____ these sample English 12 paragraphs tonight.

words.chinese: 偶然遇到
words.exampleEn: If you come across an unknown word, add it to review.
words.exampleZh: 遇到生词就加入复习。
words.gapSentence: I _____ _____ this term in the admissions guide.

words.chinese: 处理
words.exampleEn: Deal with hazards as soon as you notice them.
words.exampleZh: 一发现隐患就要处理。
words.gapSentence: How should we _____ _____ incomplete sentences in the essay?

words.chinese: 弄明白
words.exampleEn: Figure out the main idea before you summarize.
words.exampleZh: 总结前先弄清主旨。
words.gapSentence: I cannot _____ _____ why this clause is a fragment.

words.chinese: 克服；恢复
words.exampleEn: It takes time to get over the fear of speaking English.
words.exampleZh: 克服开口说英语的恐惧需要时间。
words.gapSentence: You will _____ _____ the first failed quiz if you review it.

words.chinese: 经历；仔细过一遍
words.exampleEn: Go through the rubric before you submit the paragraph.
words.exampleZh: 交段落前把评分标准过一遍。
words.gapSentence: We will _____ _____ the lockout steps one by one.

words.chinese: 编造；弥补
words.exampleEn: Do not make up evidence in an academic paragraph.
words.exampleZh: 学术段落里不要编造证据。
words.gapSentence: You can _____ _____ the missed recitation tomorrow.

words.chinese: 用完
words.exampleEn: We ran out of fasteners before noon.
words.exampleZh: 中午前紧固件就用完了。
words.gapSentence: If you _____ _____ _____ time, finish the strongest paragraph first.

words.chinese: 出现；到场
words.exampleEn: Show up 15 minutes early for the English assessment.
words.exampleZh: 英语测评请提前 15 分钟到场。
words.gapSentence: If you do not _____ _____, you may lose your test seat.

words.chinese: 处理；照顾
words.exampleEn: Take care of the spill before someone slips.
words.exampleZh: 先处理泄漏，以免有人滑倒。
words.gapSentence: Who will _____ _____ _____ the leftover materials?

words.chinese: 拒绝；调低
words.exampleEn: Turn down the radio so you can hear the alarm.
words.exampleZh: 把收音机调低，这样才能听见警报。
words.gapSentence: BCIT may _____ _____ an application that lacks English proof.

words.chinese: 小心
words.exampleEn: Watch out for wet floors near the wash station.
words.exampleZh: 清洗台附近地滑，要小心。
words.gapSentence: _____ _____ for overhead loads when you walk through the bay.

words.chinese: 写下
words.exampleEn: Write down new irregular verbs as soon as you meet them.
words.exampleZh: 一遇到新的不规则动词就写下来。
words.gapSentence: _____ _____ the measurements before you leave the job.

words.chinese: 赶上
words.exampleEn: Use Sunday to catch up on overdue reviews.
words.exampleZh: 用周日把过期复习补上。
words.gapSentence: I need to _____ _____ on the sentences I missed.

words.chinese: 落后
words.exampleEn: You will fall behind if you skip two days of review.
words.exampleZh: 连续两天不复习就会落后。
words.gapSentence: Do not _____ _____ on the due cards tonight.

words.chinese: 返回；取回
words.exampleEn: Get back to the shop after the safety orientation.
words.exampleZh: 安全培训结束后返回车间。
words.gapSentence: I will _____ _____ to you with the correct specification.

words.chinese: 继续
words.exampleEn: Go on to the next sentence after you score 80 or higher.
words.exampleZh: 达到 80 分以上再进入下一句。
words.gapSentence: Please _____ _____ with the next step in the procedure.

words.chinese: 等一下；抓紧
words.exampleEn: Hold on while I check the drawing revision.
words.exampleZh: 等一下，我核对图纸版本。
words.gapSentence: _____ _____ to the handrail as you climb.

words.chinese: 跟上；保持
words.exampleEn: Keep up the daily recitation even on busy days.
words.exampleZh: 即使忙也要保持每日背诵。
words.gapSentence: It is hard to _____ _____ if the reviews pile up.

words.chinese: 忍受
words.exampleEn: Do not put up with unsafe shortcuts on site.
words.exampleZh: 工地上不要忍受不安全的省事做法。
words.gapSentence: I will not _____ _____ _____ missing guards on this machine.

words.chinese: 碰到；遭遇
words.exampleEn: You may run into unfamiliar academic verbs in English 12 texts.
words.exampleZh: 英语 12 课文里可能会碰到不熟悉的学术动词。
words.gapSentence: We _____ _____ a problem with the thread size.

words.chinese: 扔掉
words.exampleEn: Throw away damaged PPE; do not reuse it.
words.exampleZh: 损坏的个人防护用品要扔掉，不要再用。
words.gapSentence: Do not _____ _____ the sample paragraph; it is a model.

words.chinese: 醒来；醒悟
words.exampleEn: Wake up the habit of reviewing due cards every morning.
words.exampleZh: 养成每天早上看到期卡片的习惯。
words.gapSentence: _____ _____ early so you can recite before class.

words.chinese: 下降；放下
words.exampleEn: Your accuracy will drop off if you only cram once a week.
words.exampleZh: 如果一周只突击一次，正确率会下降。
words.gapSentence: Please _____ _____ the completed form at admissions.

words.chinese: 分析
words.exampleEn: Analyze the author's purpose before you judge the argument.
words.exampleZh: 评价论证前先分析作者的意图。

words.chinese: 论点；论证
words.exampleEn: A strong argument needs a clear claim and relevant evidence.
words.exampleZh: 有力的论证需要清楚的主张和相关证据。

words.chinese: 证据
words.exampleEn: Use evidence from the text to support your point.
words.exampleZh: 用文本中的证据支撑你的观点。

words.chinese: 结论
words.exampleEn: Your conclusion should follow logically from the evidence.
words.exampleZh: 结论应从证据中合理推出。

words.chinese: 比较
words.exampleEn: Compare the two accounts and note what is missing.
words.exampleZh: 比较这两种说法，并注意缺了什么。

words.chinese: 对比
words.exampleEn: In contrast, the second source is more reliable.
words.exampleZh: 相比之下，第二个来源更可靠。

words.chinese: 评估
words.exampleEn: Evaluate whether the example actually supports the claim.
words.exampleZh: 评估这个例子是否真正支撑该主张。

words.exampleEn: From the tone, we can infer that the writer is skeptical.
words.exampleZh: 从语气可以推断作者持怀疑态度。

words.exampleZh: 用一句准确的话总结该段。

words.exampleZh: 把中心论点放在引言结尾。

words.exampleZh: 每一段都应展开一个中心意思。

words.exampleZh: 根据读者调整语气。

words.exampleEn: The purpose of this paragraph is to present a counterargument.
words.exampleZh: 这段的目的是提出反驳。

words.exampleZh: 嘲讽语气会削弱正式论证。

words.chinese: 可靠的

words.exampleZh: 这个网站作为作业来源可靠吗？

words.exampleZh: 引用数据时要标明来源。

words.exampleEn: A claim without evidence is only an opinion.
words.exampleZh: 没有证据的主张只是看法。

words.chinese: 反驳；对立论点
words.exampleEn: Address the counterargument so your essay looks fair.
words.exampleZh: 回应对立论点，文章才会显得公正。

words.chinese: 过渡

words.exampleZh: 连贯的段落始终围绕一个主题。

words.exampleEn: Delete details that are not relevant to the thesis.
words.exampleZh: 删掉与中心论点无关的细节。

words.exampleEn: Interpret the quotation; do not just copy it.
words.exampleZh: 要解释引文，而不是只抄下来。

words.exampleEn: The evidence was weak; consequently, the claim failed.
words.exampleZh: 证据不足，因此该主张不成立。

words.chinese: 然而
words.exampleEn: The method is common; however, it is not always accurate.
words.exampleZh: 这种方法很常见，但并不总是准确。

words.chinese: 所以
words.exampleEn: The source is biased; therefore, treat it with caution.
words.exampleZh: 该来源有偏见，所以要谨慎对待。

words.exampleEn: Although the idea is interesting, it lacks evidence.
words.exampleZh: 这个想法有趣，但缺少证据。
